name: Earnings-response continuation
hypothesis: Enter a liquid continuation only after the release and its real receipt time.
spec: Setup: An issuer release produces a measurable surprise against a timestamped consensus estimate. Entry: Enter a liquid continuation only after the release and its real receipt time. Exit: Exit on structure failure, time limit or session deadline. Parameters to pre-register: surprise_definition, consensus_vintage, reaction_window, liquidity_floor.
blocked_reason: needs a licensed event feed (earnings surprises, consensus, filings, auction or halt data) with receipt times
